title: Local quasi-coherence of tensor pullback
statement: For every point x of X there is an open neighbourhood U such that the tensor pullback restricted over U is quasi-coherent.

proof.text: Extract quasicoherent data q from hG. The Opens.coversTop_iff equivalence and IsOpenCover.exists_mem give a member q.X i containing g(x); choose the specific open U=g⁻¹(q.X i), which contains x.

Apply tensorModulePullback_presentation_over to the presentation q.presentation i on q.X i. The resulting global presentation of the tensor pullback over U is quasicoherent by Mathlib SheafOfModules.Presentation.isQuasicoherent.

proof_origin.place: Lemma 17.10.4, local-to-global-presentation reduction; D2 second reading formalizes the cover selection and presentation-to-quasicoherence steps

lean.statement:
theorem tensorModulePullback_isQuasicoherent_local
    {X Y : RingedSpace.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y)
    (G : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y)) (hG : G.IsQuasicoherent) (x : X) :
    ∃ U : TopologicalSpace.Opens X, x ∈ U ∧
      ((SheafOfModules.changeOfRings.{u, u, u}
        (CochainComplex.tensorPullbackRingMap g.hom.base X.sheaf Y.sheaf ⟨g.hom.c⟩)
        (TopCat.Sheaf.inverseImageModule g.hom.base Y.sheaf G)).over U).IsQuasicoherent
